description: Multiplier is the keyword used when we want to multiply any value in the strategy as per the multiplier selected during that deployment.
how_to_use_markdown:
Multiplier is the keyword used when we want to multiply any value in the strategy as per the multiplier selected during that deployment.

Useful, if the user wants to deploy using different multiplier like 2X,5X etc

If deployment is under 2X, multiplier will return 2

![Example](./images/img-1631710845.png)

raw_scraped_text:
Multiplier
 Multiplier is the keyword used when we want to multiply any value in the strategy as per the multiplier selected during that deployment.
Useful, if the user wants to deploy using different multiplier like 2X,5X etc
If deployment is under 2X, multiplier will return 2
